Here's a summary of the **7 issues** found and fixed:

| # | Problem | Fix |
|---|---------|-----|
| 1 | **Import error on fresh clone** — `Import` of `eng\custom-analyzers.props` had no guard | Added `Condition="Exists(…)"` on all imports |
| 2 | **NuGet hook stopped working** — `CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` was set in `Directory.Build.targets`, which loads *after* `Microsoft.Common.targets` | Moved to `Directory.Build.props` |
| 3 | **NuGet package injection blocked** — `ImportByWildcard*=false` prevented packages like `MyAnalyzer.BuildTasks` from injecting their `.props/.targets` | Removed those properties |
| 4 | **Circular import condition** — `Common.props` was imported only when `CommonPropsImported==true`, but that property is *defined inside* `Common.props` | Changed to `Exists()` condition |
| 5 | **Missing parent chain** — `hard/` files didn't chain to repo-root `Directory.Build.*`, losing `RepoRoot` and repo-wide targets | Added `GetPathOfFileAbove` imports |
| 6 | **No extensibility** — code-gen targets had no hook point for other teams | Added `DependsOnTargets` property-list pattern (`RunCodeGenDependsOn`, `GenerateAssemblyInfoDependsOn`) |
| 7 | **Fragile internal target** — `AfterTargets="_CopyFilesMarkedCopyLocal"` relies on a private SDK target | Changed to public `CopyFilesToOutputDirectory` |
